title: 7.99% Property Tax Increase Vote and Hearing
summary:
*   **Proposed Tax Hike Approved:** The city's proposed property tax rate increase was set at 7.99%, following a council vote.
*   **Public Hearing Scheduled:** A public hearing on the proposed 7.99% property tax increase was scheduled for September 16, 1982, at 7:00 PM in the Electric Building Auditorium.
*   **Notices to be Published:** Information regarding the proposed tax increase and public hearing will be published in both English and Spanish.

Mayor McClellan called the meeting to order, noting the absence of Councilman Goodman.
Mayor McClellan stated that this was an Emergency Special Called Council Meeting for the
purpose of considering the following: 1. Taking a vote on the proposed property tax rate
increase.
2. Setting a public hearing on the proposed property tax rate increase.
3. Publishing notices on the proposed property tax rate increase.
Regarding the "Notice of Public Hearing on Tax Increase," City Attorney Albert DeLaRosa
stated that the Research & Budget Department had informed him that the City Manager's
proposed budget called for a 7.67% tax increase. If the Council placed that percentage
increase in the Notice, then that amount could not be exceeded. Motion Councilman Mullen
moved the Council set the amount at 7.98%. Mayor McClellan seconded the motion. Substitute
Motion Councilman Duncan offered a substitute motion that the amount be set at 7.99%. The
motion, seconded by Councilman Deuser, carried by a 6-0 Vote, Councilman Goodman absent. :

PUBLIC HEARING SET
September 7, 1982
The Council, on Mayor Pro Tem Trevino's motion, Councilman Duncan's second, set a public
hearing on the proposed property tax rate increase for 7:00 p.m., September 16, 1982. (6-0
Vote, Councilman Goodman absent) (Public hearing to be held in the Electric Building
Auditorium) The Council agreed to publish notices on the proposed property tax rate
increase in both English and Spanish with no explanatory notice as had been done
previously.
ADJOURNMENT
The Council adjourned at 5:15 p.m.
